description: Use this when the user asks how much a car model costs in Slovakia, or whether a price for a model is reasonable. Returns the median ASKING price of the brand/model (optionally one model year) in AutoIsto's current offer, the sample size, the price range and the date. The median is omitted below 20 cars with a plain price. These are prices sellers ask, not sale prices; mileage and equipment move the price, so present it as a guide. Do not use it for valuing a specific car's condition, for new-car prices or for markets outside Slovakia.

brand.description: Car brand, e.g. Škoda, Volkswagen, BMW (abbreviations such as VW work).

model.description: Model, e.g. Octavia, Golf, X5, Rad 3, C trieda (English names such as 3 Series or C-Class also work — the interpretation is returned). Versions, body variants and generations (RS, Variant, B8) are not separated: figures cover the whole model and notApplied says so. Omit for the whole brand.

year.description: Model year, only together with model.

name: get_model_price

interpretation.description: How the model name was understood when AutoIsto knows it under another name ("3 Series" → Rad 3, "320d" → Rad 3). Tell the user.

listedCount.description: Cars of this brand/model(/year) in the offer today.

medianAskingPriceEur.description: Median ASKING price; null when fewer than 20 cars have a plain price.

notApplied.description: Part of the requested model the figures do NOT reflect (version, body, generation, e.g. "RS", "Variant", "B8"): figures cover the whole model. Tell the user.

sampleSize.description: Cars the median is computed from.

scope.description: What the figures cover. "brand" when no model was given — a year is applied only together with a model, see note.

title: Get typical asking price
